design_philosophy: Strict monochrome minimalism. Vercel meets Linear. Pure high-contrast structure focusing on negative space, typography, and crisp borders. Zero gradients. Zero colorful icons. Every pixel must have purpose.
theme_strategy: Pure Black & White. Light mode default for trust and clarity, with seamless Dark mode for professional aesthetics.

headings.rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all Headings (H1-H4). Never use Inter for headings. Ensure tight letter spacing (-0.02em to -0.04em).

body.rules: Use Inter exclusively for body text, inputs, labels, and data tables to maximize legibility.

colors.rules: Strict adherence to monochrome. DO NOT use colored semantic states (no green for success, no red for error). Use bold text, icons, or subtle borders to indicate state instead.

corners.buttons: rounded-full (pill-shape) or rounded-lg depending on context (prefer pill for landing, lg for dashboard)

shadows.rules: Shadows must be barely visible. Rely primarily on borders to define depth.

surfaces.glass: bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10

landing.hero: Massive typography, centered or sharp left-aligned. High use of negative space (py-32). Include a floating Dashboard mockup with glassmorphism overlapping the bottom.
landing.features: Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).

dashboards.shell: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main content area. Top header for breadcrumbs and user actions.
dashboards.content: Max-width containers (max-w-7xl). Dense data layout with generous padding within cards.
dashboards.grid: High density grid for stats and job lists. Cards should have h-full to match neighbors.

buttons.primary: bg-black text-white hover:bg-black/90 dark:bg-white dark:text-black dark:hover:bg-white/90 transition-transform active:scale-95 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-black dark:text-white border border-[#E5E5E5] dark:border-[#222222] hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-zinc-900 transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium

cards.job_card: Flex col layout. Top: Company logo (monochrome) + Job Title. Middle: Pill badges for Skills/Remote/Budget. Bottom: Post date + Apply CTA. Actionable via entire card wrapping.

badges.outline: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-transparent text-black dark:text-white border border-[#E5E5E5] dark:border-[#222222]

inputs.search: Add subtle left icon (search). Same styling as default.

motion.hover: Scale down slightly (scale: 0.98) or lift up (y: -4) depending on component size. Quick spring physics.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight upward translation (y: 10 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1, duration: 0.4s).
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for Job lists and features.

images.instruction: All images MUST be forced into monochrome using CSS if not already black and white (e.g., filter: grayscale(100%) contrast(120%)).

hero_mockup_bg.description: Minimal monochrome startup room (use for decorative background sections or subtle parallax)

company_logos.description: Abstract monochrome logo 1 (Use in job cards)
Abstract monochrome logo 2 (Use in trusted-by section)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure black/white combinations meet APCA and WCAG AAA standards.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have a visible focus ring (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black dark:focus:ring-white focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-black`).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, inputs, links, and key elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="job-apply-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Cabinet Grotesk from Fontshare and Inter from Google Fonts via <link> tags in the HTML head.
Apply `font-sans` globally but override Headings (h1, h2, h3, h4) with Cabinet Grotesk.
Enforce strict black and white styling. Do not introduce grays darker than #666 unless it's for text.
Ensure the header is sticky with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur).
Use Phosphor Icons (or Lucide) and ensure all icons are strictly monochrome. NO colorful icons.
In the landing page, create a striking 'Trusted By' section using grayscale logos with high spacing.
Implement the filtering system for Job Listings using sleek pill-shaped toggle buttons instead of standard checkboxes.
Ensure all Shadcn components (if used) have their border radiuses and border colors overridden to match the 12px-16px `#E5E5E5` styling.
Use `framer-motion` for a premium feel on page load and component mounting. Add hover scaling to job cards.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. Preserve standard top-to-bottom, left-to-right reading flows.
Use 2x-3x more spacing (padding/margins) than typical defaults. Embrace whitespace as a premium design element.
Never use generic default gradients. This project specifically FORBIDS gradients.
Avoid AI slop aesthetics: No generic rounded colored blobs, no floating isometric illustrations. Stick strictly to typographic hierarchy and structural borders.
Include `data-testid` attributes on every interactive element for testing.
For the hero dashboard mockup, build a miniature UI using HTML/Tailwind rather than an actual image, layered with absolute positioning and soft shadows.
Toasts must use `sonner` styled with pure black background, white text, and sharp borders.
